meta.name: arize-prompt-optimization
meta.description: INVOKE THIS SKILL when optimizing, improving, or debugging LLM prompts using production trace data, evaluations, and annotations. Also use when the user wants to make their AI respond better or improve AI output quality. Covers extracting prompts from spans, gathering performance signal, and running a data-driven optimization loop using the ax CLI.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用生产数据优化提示词，提升AI输出质量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用LLM并希望基于真实反馈迭代提示词
copy.tagline_en: Optimize prompts using production trace data to improve AI output
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LLMs and want to iterate prompts based on real feedback

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会利用生产追踪数据、评估分数和标注来分析和改进提示词，通过 ax CLI 工具提取、测试并迭代提示词版本。
howto.when: 当用户要求优化提示词，或提到提升AI输出质量时触发。

say.text: 帮我用生产数据优化这个提示词。
say.note: Claude 将提取性能数据并生成改进版本。

say.text: 分析这个提示词的评估分数。
say.note: Claude 会查看评估标注并指出失败模式。

say.text: 比较两个提示词的实验结果。
say.note: Claude 会并排比较平均分数和失败案例。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude uses production trace data, evaluation scores, and annotations to analyze and improve prompts, using the ax CLI to extract, test, and iterate on prompt versions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to optimize prompts or improve AI output quality.

say_en.text: Help me optimize this prompt using production data.
say_en.note: Claude will extract performance data and generate an improved version.

say_en.text: Analyze the evaluation scores for this prompt.
say_en.note: Claude will review evaluation labels and identify failure patterns.

say_en.text: Compare experiment results between two prompts.
say_en.note: Claude will compare average scores and failure flips.
